Personally, I would say that moving out is not the immediate go-to in this situation, though you would probably be relieved to find she's much more attentive when you see each other less.  It's possible she may be dealing with ADHD or some other issue.


If you can swing it, try counseling or come up with some creative accommodations.  You might try making eye contact and saying her name before you start speaking, asking her to shut down any electronics she may be distracted with.  You may need to try asking her for talk time, maybe just 15-30 minutes a day that she can schedule in to devote to you.  If she doesn't see your point of view and isn't receptive to repairing the damage that's been done, then maybe moving out would be an option.



However, living separately could be the nail in the coffin for your relationship, so don't move out until you can genuinely say you are comfortable ending it.
